title: tc-ops-overview
description:
An operations overview strip – a status line, a health pill and count tiles, each with its change since the last
period in words and colour, an optional sparkline and tone, optionally actionable.

status.description: The one-line status under the heading: "All operations active · 3 analysts on watch"

health.description: The feeds' or systems' health; unset hides the pill

healthLabels.description: The health states' names, merged over the defaults (Feeds nominal, Feeds degraded, Feeds down)

changeLabel.description: What a change is measured against, for screen readers and titles: "since last week"

actionable.description: Makes the tiles buttons that fire tc-action

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "de"; by default the browser's

value.description: The count, or any short value ("94%")

sub.description: One quiet line under the value: "tracked", "projects active"

change.description: The change since the last period, e.g. 2 or -1; 0 shows "no change"

goodWhen.description: Which way is good: "up" (default), "down" (alerts, risks) or "none" (neither – the badge stays neutral)

trend.description: Recent values, oldest first, drawn as a sparkline

tone.description: Tints the value: danger for "Critical risk"
